Match List-I and List-II
List-I
List-II
Name of vitamins Deficiency Disease 
(A) Vitamin - A
(I) Increase in fragility of RBC
(B) Vitamin - E
(II) Increased blood clotting time
(C) Vitamin - C
(III) Xerophthalmia 
(D) Vitamin - K
(IV) Scurvy
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Detailed Solution:
Step 1: Identify the deficiency disease for Vitamin A. NCERT states Vitamin A deficiency causes Xerophthalmia and night blindness. Hence, (A) matches with (III).
Step 2: Identify the deficiency disease for Vitamin E. Vitamin E deficiency leads to increased fragility of RBCs and muscular weakness. Hence, (B) matches with (I).
Step 3: Identify the deficiency disease for Vitamin C. Vitamin C deficiency results in Scurvy (bleeding gums). Hence, (C) matches with (IV).
Step 4: Identify the deficiency disease for Vitamin K. Vitamin K is responsible for blood coagulation, so its deficiency results in an increased blood clotting time. Hence, (D) matches with (II).
Step 5: Combine the pairings: (A)-(III), (B)-(I), (C)-(IV), (D)-(II), which matches Option B.
Hence, option (A) is the correct match.
Hence, option (D) is the correct match.
